prompt: GET /customers/{customer}/orders is slow for customers with many orders: it runs one query per order to load the lines. Make it load the orders and their lines in a constant number of queries (at most 2) without changing the response, and add the missing index for looking up lines by order with a new Flyway migration. V1 is already applied in production, so it must not change. PostgreSQL 18 runs locally (database and user `app`; `pg-up` starts it if needed). Run the tests with `sh test.sh` (Maven works offline: every dependency is already in ~/.m2).
